# pcd_identity_domain (Data Source)

Look up a domain in PCD's Keystone identity service by ID or name, for example to reference the `Default` domain or a domain the PCD UI created. `pcd_identity_project` cannot find domains: Keystone leaves them out of the project list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pcd_identity_domain" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Look up the domain by ID (takes precedence over `name`).
- `name` (String) Look up the domain by its exact name.
- `region` (String) The region whose identity endpoint is used; defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The domain description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain is enabled.
- `id` (String) The domain ID.
